csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Trappe, in coordination with the Home Run Baker Little League, is seeking proposals from qualified firms to provide design-build construction services to construct a dedicated Girls Softball Field that meets Little League Girls Softball standards. The porject will include acquisition and installation of all necessary materials, to include site preparation, field construction,, stormwater Management, backstop fencing, outfield fencing, dugouts, bleachers, batting cage, relocation of the previously installed electronic scoreboard, and installation of plumbed public ADA restrooms.
